A Triggerman that’s got more combat experience, more gear, and more wins under their belt. Not far off from being considered a true cyberpunk.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Mercs).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.
Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.

Internal Body Cyberware.

Use an Action to load one dose of Street Drug into a subdermal storage pod. Optionally, one can configure a Biomonitor to automatically dose the user upon entering combat, suffering a critical injury, or reaching a predetermined Wound State threshold.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 1 minute.

  • +3 to any Initiative Rolls. If already in combat, +3 to current Initiative.

Secondary (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • -2 to Initiative Rolls while addicted if not currently dosed with TimeWarp.
Provides immunity to deafness or sudden loud noises.
